limitations: Originality is to the best of current inspection. The theorem is restricted to infinite discrete groups, right-diagonally invariant relative Toeplitz patterns, Banach Schatten classes \(1\le p<\infty\), and \(S_\infty=K\). Hladnik (2000) remained full-text inaccessible.
provenance: A near-norm finite block is replicated by simultaneous right translations into disjoint row/column blocks; exact Schatten block sums and escaping compressions yield the s-number and noncompactness profiles.
record_title: Flat s-number and strict-singularity profiles of relative Toeplitz Schur multipliers
